newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U/Amersham merger to face $100 mln restructure.
newsitem.headline: P&U/Amersham merger to face $100 mln restructure.

text.p: New company Amersham Pharmacia Biotech will face one-off restructuring costs of up to $100 million after the merger of the life science units of Pharmacia & Upjohn British health and technology group Amersham International.
"We have preliminarily estimated one off costs of about $100 million," Julian Cooper, head of personnel at the new company told a news conference.
"This will give savings of $45-50 million a year from the third year (April-March 2000/01)."
P&U unit Pharmacia Biotech and Amersham Life Science announced a merger early Tuesday to form a Amersham Pharmacia Biotech.
Cooper said a small part of the one-off costs will be incurred in the 1997/98 financial year but the majority of this will affect years 1998/99 and 1999/2000.
About 10 percent of the 3,600 jobs in the new merged company will be cut, according to preliminary estimates.
Rationalisations will hit all areas of the new company.
"But this does not mean that 10 percent of employees will lose their jobs," Cooper said.
"There are a number of jobs vacant and another lot will be lost through natural wastage," he said.
